'''N-3PO''', or '''Enthree''', was a [[Shard (species)|Shard]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] spy, who was masquerading as a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]]. He was infiltrated on the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Thunder (Star Destroyer)|''Thunder'']] and served as [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Tobal Siy]]'s personal assistant, and used this position to inform Rebel agents of his movements against them.
